parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description:
The data storage bucket. The default value is default. You can specify a custom bucket to group services and prevent path conflicts.

> eci-system is a reserved bucket for ECI and cannot be used.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EipCreateParam
parameters.description:
The parameters for creating and attaching an EIP.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to pull data from the Internet.

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of an existing elastic IP address (EIP) to be attached.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to pull data from the Internet.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data cache.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path where the data is stored.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description: The number of days to retain the data cache. The data cache is cleared after it expires. By default, the data cache never expires.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group for the ECI instance that is generated during the data cache creation process.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size of the data cache. Unit: GiB. The default value is 20 GiB. Evaluate the required size based on the actual amount of data.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags to attach to the data cache.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch for the ECI instance that is generated during the data cache creation process.
